topic: Changes in Matter Illustrated in Diagrams and Flowcharts
key_concepts: Matter exists in solid, liquid, and gas states.
A phase change is a change from one state of matter to another.
Melting is the phase change from solid to liquid.
Freezing is the phase change from liquid to solid.
Condensation is the phase change from gas to liquid.
Evaporation is the phase change from liquid to gas.
Heating can cause melting and evaporation.
Cooling can cause freezing and condensation.
Phase changes can be represented using flowcharts with arrows showing direction.
Real-world examples illustrate phase changes in matter.
